name: Order Solution Design - SEQ1
code:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant C as Customer
    participant UI as Web / Mobile App
    participant Cart as Cart Service
    participant Price as Pricing Engine
    participant Promo as Promotion Service
    participant Tax as Tax Service
    participant Order as Order 1
    participant Fraud as Fraud Service
    participant Pay as Payment Gateway
    participant Inv as Inventory Service
    participant Ship as Shipping Service
    participant Notif as Notification Service
    participant Bus as Event Bus

    %% Cart Building
    C->>UI: Browse & Add Items
    UI->>Cart: AddItem(productId, qty)
    Cart->>Price: Calculate Price
    Price->>Promo: Apply Discounts
    Promo->>Tax: Calculate Tax
    Tax-->>Cart: Final Amount
    Cart-->>UI: Cart Summary

    %% Checkout
    C->>UI: Checkout
    UI->>Order: Create Order (PENDING_PAYMENT)
    Order-->>UI: Order ID

    %% Fraud & Payment
    Order->>Fraud: Risk Assessment
    alt High Risk
        Fraud-->>Order: Flagged
        Order->>Notif: Notify Manual Review
        Order-->>UI: Order On Hold
    else Low Risk
        Fraud-->>Order: Approved
        Order->>Pay: Authorize Payment
        alt Payment Failed
            Pay-->>Order: Failed
            Order->>Notif: Payment Failure
            Order-->>UI: Order Cancelled
        else Payment Authorized
            Pay-->>Order: Authorized
        end
    end

    %% Inventory
    Order->>Inv: Reserve Stock
    alt Out of Stock
        Inv-->>Order: Reservation Failed
        Order->>Pay: Release Authorization
        Order->>Notif: Out of Stock
    else Partial Stock
        Inv-->>Order: Partial Reserved
        Order->>Ship: Create Split Shipments
    else Fully Reserved
        Inv-->>Order: Reserved
        Order->>Ship: Create Shipment
    end

    %% Shipping
    Ship->>Ship: Allocate Warehouse
    Ship->>Ship: Generate Label
    Ship-->>Order: Tracking Number

    %% Notification & Events
    Order->>Notif: Order Confirmed
    Notif-->>C: Email / SMS

    Order->>Bus: Publish OrderCreated
    Bus-->>Analytics: Update Metrics
    Bus-->>CRM: Update Customer Profile
    Bus-->>Recommender: Train Model

    %% Delivery
    Ship-->>Order: Delivered
    Order->>Notif: Delivery Confirmation
